test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Southern states has made an impressive comeback in the latest rankings.
solution:
The correct option is **"option 4".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The error lies in option 4 of the sentence.
 
• Here, we can use "have" in place of "has" to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• In Subject-verb agreement, we use a singular verb with a singular noun or pronoun or do verb change as per the tense and a plural verb with a plural noun or pronoun.​
 
 
• **Example:** *They **have **elected a new president.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "**Southern states**" are a **plural noun, **and we use the plural verb with a plural noun.
 
• So, we replace the singular verb "has" with the plural verb "have" to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• All the other options are correct.

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

Correct sentence__: ***Southern states __have__ made** an impressive comeback in the latest rankings.*
